---
title: "Screening in a state's counties, with rurality"
---

This is the same measure/release query the [Home](/index.qmd) map's data
was built from — run here **live**, against the real, 23-million-row
`measure.observation` table, through DuckDB-WASM in your own browser.
Scoped to one state rather than the whole country: PLACES's own PLACES
partition is written as one very large Parquet file per release, and a
national-scope live read of it is exactly the pattern that fails
intermittently in this DuckDB-WASM build
([cancer-on-ice#120](https://github.com/seandavi/cancer-on-ice/issues/120)).
One state at a time stays well inside the sizes that read reliably.

{{< include _duckdb-shared.qmd >}}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
MEASURES = [
  { measure_id: "PLACES:CANCER:age_adjusted", label: "Cancer (non-skin) or melanoma" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:COLON_SCREEN:age_adjusted", label: "Colorectal cancer screening" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:MAMMOUSE:age_adjusted", label: "Mammography use" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:CSMOKING:age_adjusted", label: "Current cigarette smoking" },
  { measure_id: "PLACES:CHECKUP:age_adjusted", label: "Annual checkup" }
]
RELEASES = ["2025", "2024"]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof stateChoice = Inputs.select(US_STATES, {
  label: "State",
  format: (d) => d.name,
  value: US_STATES.find((s) => s.fips === "08")
})
viewof measureChoice = Inputs.select(MEASURES, { label: "Measure", format: (d) => d.label, value: MEASURES[0] })
viewof releaseChoice = Inputs.select(RELEASES, { label: "Release" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sql = `SELECT u.name, o.value AS pct, o.lower, o.upper, o.value_status, r.value AS rucc_code
FROM coi.measure.observation o
JOIN coi.geography.unit u
  ON u.geo_id = o.geo_id AND u.vintage = 2026 AND u.valid_to IS NULL
LEFT JOIN coi.measure.observation r
  ON r.geo_id = o.geo_id AND r.source = 'RUCC' AND r.valid_to IS NULL
WHERE o.source = 'PLACES' AND o.measure_id = '${measureChoice.measure_id}'
  AND o.source_release = '${releaseChoice}' AND u.parent_geo_id = 'state:${stateChoice.fips}'
  AND o.valid_to IS NULL
ORDER BY pct`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState = {
  sql; // reactive dependency
  if (dbState.status !== "ready") return dbState;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  try {
    const result = await dbState.conn.query(sql);
    return { status: "ready", rows: rowsFromArrow(result), ms: performance.now() - t0 };
  } catch (error) {
    return { status: "error", error };
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
renderStatus(dbState, queryState)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
queryState.status === "ready"
  ? Inputs.table(queryState.rows, { columns: ["name", "pct", "lower", "upper", "value_status", "rucc_code"] })
  : html`<p><em>Table will render once the query returns.</em></p>`
```
